Kayla Zhou: hi all! first day as infra eng, excited to be here :wave: quick intro — poured a lot of coffee today, vintage tin collector :coffee: Fun fact: I once repaired a broken espresso machine with duct tape.; Kayla Zhou: small snag — MDM enrollment fails at 'Installing profile' on my MacBook Pro (macOS 13.5). Okta showed the invite but the device setup hangs. Who should I ping for reprovision or a loaner? Need VPN and repo access too.; Samir Patel: welcome Kayla!! :tada: I
m Samir, infra. Ian be your buddy this week. Pinged IT Support for MDM and badge. I
lso added you to #platform and #benchmarks.; IT Support: Hi Kayla 
nd welcome. For the MDM error try: 1) System Settings > Profiles > remove any old profiles; 2) reboot; 3) use the Okta enrollment link on corporate wifi. If that still fails we can: a) remote re-provision today 3-5pm PST, or b) provide a loaner image URL so you can boot and start work now. Which do you prefer? Also share your shipping address if we need to send hardware.; Kayla Zhou: thanks — loaner image would be great so I can start today. shipping not needed yet. Also need badge access for the office; HR Bot: Welcome Kayla! Badge provisioning is in progress. Please complete the new-hire form if you haven't: https://intranet.redwood/newhire. Swag queued.; Ops Bot: Badge locker code and pickup window will be posted here shortly. Office tour scheduled tomorrow 10:30am PST.; Alex Gomez: for repo perms, open a GH ticket with your handle and repo name. Meanwhile, Samir — I can share a temporary SSH jump host if Kayla needs to access build runners before keys are set.; Samir Patel: once you have SSH keys ready, add to GitHub: ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "kayla@redwood.com" then pbcopy the pubkey. Ian review your first PR on the benchmarks repo.; Kayla Zhou: copying steps, will try the loaner image and report back. thanks for the warm welcome — see you all on the sync later :smile:
